observed_outcome: Model Gateway enforces binding profile authorization and egress policy before every model, fallback, and embedding call. Under egress:local-only, when the primary local profile fails (timeout) and a cloud fallback profile is configured, the gateway refuses with egress_denied, sets analysis_status=model_failed, and makes 0 calls to the cloud provider. Cloud embedding profiles under egress:local-only are likewise refused with egress_denied and 0 provider calls.
